overview.body:
## Welcome

This workshop examines inflation drivers and CPI application.

knowledge_summary.body: Core inflation concepts include demand-pull and cost-push dynamics.

visual_affordances.subject: Inflation mechanism classification cues
visual_affordances.context: Visual brief: compare demand-pull, cost-push, and wage-price spiral mechanisms by triggering drivers and transmission pathways.
allowed_claims: Different causal mechanisms can produce inflation.
visual_affordances.rationale: Classify scenarios by mechanism before the analysis table.
visual_affordances.pedagogical_added_value: Adds discriminating cause-type cues — not a blank copy of the learner table.
visual_affordances.caption_intent: Cause-type cues only — not the learner table.

visual_affordances.subject: CPI index discrimination
visual_affordances.context: Visual brief: learners should complete the worked comparison table before any visual summary.
visual_affordances.rationale: Attempt the worked example before any visual summary.

visual_affordances.subject: Debrief-only closure
visual_affordances.context: Visual brief: debrief prose already communicates the closure move without new inferential load.
visual_affordances.rationale: Debrief text is sufficient; a visual would duplicate closure.

visual_affordances.subject: Knowledge Summary inference map
visual_affordances.context: Visual brief: after Knowledge Summary prose, synthesize how demand-pull and cost-push connect to CPI interpretation risks.
disallowed_claims: Causal claims not present in source summary.
visual_affordances.rationale: Knowledge Summary benefits from a synthesis visual linking concepts.
visual_affordances.caption_intent: Map how core knowledge-summary ideas connect.
visual_affordances.reasoning_supported: Connect drivers, CPI reading, and judgement risks.
visual_affordances.canonical_discipline_note: Use only knowledge-summary concepts and links.
